summary: CreateCrewAccessToken: the request a viewer sends for one Crew, and the short-lived access token the backend answers with.

provisional.why: awsJson1_0 per the backend model, POST / with X-Amz-Target KiroControlPlaneBearerService.CreateCrewAccessToken.
Epoch seconds, the awsJson1_0 default. Clients also accept ISO 8601 UTC strings.

fields.accessToken: Always. A credential: never logged, never stored on disk.
fields.expiresAt: Always. When the token ends, on the backend's clock. The viewer counts the lifetime from the answer's Date header, not its own clock.
fields.renewInSeconds: When to mint the next one, already spread by the backend.
